papers.title: UniJEPA: A Unified Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Task-Agnostic Visual World Modeling
papers.authors: An Lanji, Dawei Liu, Jin Li, Haoran Xu, Mei Chen, Yu Tian
papers.affiliations: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Chengdu, China
papers.intro: UniJEPA提出一种统一的联合嵌入预测架构，在共享潜在空间中同时学习光度预测（图像级变换）和时间预测（视频级动态），使用单一高斯正则化器实现可证明的防坍塌，并支持可控抽象和零样本规划。

papers.title: LitTraceQA: A Benchmark for Multi-Stage Grounding and Verification in Scientific Question Answering
papers.authors: Xuye Liu, Yimu Wang, Peng Shi, Bo Xue, Xiangrui Ke, Songcheng Cai, Kath Choi, Di Wu, Freda Shi, Krzysztof Czarnecki
papers.affiliations: University of Waterloo, Amazon, City University of Hong Kong, University of Amsterdam
papers.intro: LitTraceQA 是一个科学文献问答基准，要求系统同时输出相关论文标识、类型化证据位置和最终答案，以显式评估从论文检索到证据定位再到答案生成的完整可验证链路。

papers.title: H2AL: Hyperbolic Hierarchy-aware Aggregative Learning for Registration-based Few-shot Medical Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Jia Wang, Jiaming Cai, Zunying Hu, Zhanjie Wu, Jinyuan Liu, Hua Cheng, Yun Peng
papers.affiliations: Dalian University of Technology; Beijing Children’s Hospital, Capital Medical University; Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications
papers.intro: H2AL提出一个双曲层次感知聚合学习框架，通过向欧氏空间注入双曲层次先验，并采用梯度聚合联合优化配准与分割，从而提升配准伪标签质量和少样本医学图像分割性能，尤其针对小解剖结构。

papers.title: Same Attention, Different Truths: Put Logit-Lens over Visual Attention to Detect and Mitigate LVLM Object Hallucination
papers.authors: Zichuan Wang, Songlin Yang, Bo Peng, Zhenchen Tang, Yang Li, Beibei Dong, Jing Dong
papers.tags: multimodal learning, image captioning, visual grounding, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: School of Artificial Intelligence, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; New Laboratory of Pattern Recognition, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Science; Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
papers.intro: 本文通过Logit Lens解码视觉注意力区域中的语义内容，发现真实与幻觉对象在注意力强度上无显著差异但在语义解码上存在一致性差异，据此将对象幻觉划分为视觉不确定性和上下文先验两类，并提出一种无需训练的"检测-缓解"框架，在多个幻觉基准上取得最优性能。

papers.title: Gaze Behavior in Visual World Experiments Can be Modeled With Off-the-shelf Language-Vision Encoders
papers.authors: Rahul Murali Shankar, Titus von der Malsburg, Sebastian Padó
papers.affiliations: University of Stuttgart, Germany
papers.intro: 本文提出一种无需微调、无需生成架构的零样本方法，通过将现成的CLIP双编码器与集成雅可比（Integrated Jacobians）归因相结合，成功预测了视觉世界实验中的注视行为，并复现了经典研究中的人类预测性加工效应。

papers.title: WNM-3D: A World Navigation Model with 3D Scene Conditioning for Closed-Loop VLN
papers.authors: Yuehao Huang, Yunzi Wu, Xiaotao Zhang, Xinhai Li, Jiankun Dong, Jiajun Lv, Chi Zhang, Chenjia Bai, Yong Liu, Xuelong Li
papers.affiliations: Institute of Artificial Intelligence, China Telecom; Zhejiang University; Tongji University; Shanghai Jiao Tong University
papers.intro: WNM-3D 提出一种基于3D场景条件的世界导航模型，通过将单目RGB历史编码为几何感知场景前缀，并以块因果注意力联合生成未来视图和导航动作，在连续VLN中实现了更优的闭环导航性能。

papers.title: InstanceSplat: Instance-Aware Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting for Scene Understanding
papers.authors: Minchao Jiang, Xiaoxuan Ma, Shunyu Jia, Haoru Wang, Zhang Liang, Wentao Zhu
papers.affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Eastern Institute of Technology, Ningbo; Carnegie Mellon University; Xidian University; Peking University
papers.intro: 本文提出 InstanceSplat，一个统一的前馈式 3DGS 框架，从无位姿多视图图像中单次前向构建实例感知高斯表示，同时联合实现可泛化的新视角合成、实例分割和开放词汇语义理解。

papers.title: Human-AI Perceptual Alignment by Playing Hues and Cues
papers.authors: Nuria Alabau-Bosque, Jorge Vila-Tomás, Paula Daudén-Oliver, Pablo Hernández-Cámara, Valero Laparra, Jesús Malo
papers.affiliations: Image Processing Lab, Universitat de València
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种基于棋盘游戏Hues and Cues的离散色彩空间评估框架，将480个棋盘颜色映射至CIE xy色度图，通过325名人类观察者建立一致性基线并评估162个CVLM模型，揭示了模型在抽象概念上系统性地偏离人类基线并出现“默认蓝色”塌缩现象。

papers.title: Beyond Fluency: A Clinical Benchmark and Anomaly-Enhanced Baseline for Spine MRI Report Generation
papers.authors: Bruno Palau, Franziska Vogt, Daria Laslo, Haobo Li, Ender Konukoglu, Maria Monzon, Catherine R. Jutzeler
papers.affiliations: ETH Zurich（所有作者），Swiss Institute of Bioinformatics (SIB)（Maria Monzon, Catherine R. Jutzeler）
papers.intro: 论文针对腰椎MRI报告生成，指出现有语言指标无法反映诊断正确性，并提出一个架构无关的异常引导框架——利用半监督U-Net++生成椎间盘级异常热图作为辅助视觉输入，同时用于VLM报告生成和独立临床可解释性输出。

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Camera Localization for Bronchoscopy
papers.authors: Lumin Chen, Qingyao Tian, Jinpeng Li, Haoyu Jiang, Huai Liao, Xinyan Huang, Hongbin Liu, Dong Yi
papers.affiliations: Centre for Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Hong Kong Institute of Science & Innovation, Chinese Academy of Sciences; Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences; The First Affiliated Hospital, Sun Yat-sen University
papers.intro: 本文提出一个统一的几何感知支气管镜定位框架（GABL），通过融合术前CT导出的锚点图先验与术中RGB-D视频，采用锚点粗到精定位、Transformer时序跟踪和RGB-深度匹配，实现了高精度、实时的6-DoF相机姿态估计。

papers.title: Debias in Text, Believe Your Eyes: Text-Anchored Cross-Modal Transfer for Visual Counter-Commonsense Reasoning
papers.authors: Chen Ling, Hanqian Li, Dongnan Liu, Keyu Qian, Jungang Li, Xinglong liu, Shiyi Wang, Xin Dong, Pengcheng Zhu, Wei Zhou, Linjian Mo, Nai Ding
papers.affiliations: Zhejiang University; The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou); Ant Group; Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications; Nanyang Technological University
papers.intro: 本文提出 TACT，一种仅使用文本监督的后训练框架，通过事实频率蒸馏构造反常识文本语料，并对共享语言解码器进行两阶段优化，从而将“证据跟随”能力从文本迁移到视觉反常识推理，显著提升 MLLMs 的先验抗性。

papers.title: Rhetorical-Role-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Legal Question Answering over Indian Supreme Court Judgments
papers.authors: Sayed Ayaan Ahmed Sha, Sangeetha Sivanesan, Anand Kumar Madasamy, Navya Binu
papers.affiliations: National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli；National Institute of Karnataka, Surathkal
papers.intro: 本文提出一种领域特定的修辞角色感知RAG框架，通过基于修辞角色的分块、融合检索、交叉编码器重排序和意图感知过滤，显著提升了印度最高法院判决法律问答的检索相关性与生成答案质量。

papers.title: CoDAT: Collaborative Dual-Attention Transformer with Low-Cost Temporal Modeling for Efficient Edge Action Recognition
papers.authors: Novendra Setyawan, Chi-Chia Sun, Mao-Hsiu Hsu, Wen-Kai Kuo, Jing-Ming Guo, Jun-Wei Hsieh
papers.affiliations: 国立台湾科技大学、国立虎尾科技大学、国立阳明交通大学等（详见第十二节）
papers.intro: 本文提出CoDAT，一种结合空间卷积注意力与步进单头注意力的轻量级双分支Transformer，并嵌入零参数时序移位模块，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算和能量开销，实现边缘IoT设备上的实时动作识别。

papers.title: UQ-Loc: Uncertainty-Aware LiDAR Scene Coordinate Regression
papers.authors: Jacek Komorowski
papers.affiliations: Warsaw University of Technology, Warsaw, Poland
papers.intro: 本文提出UQ-Loc，通过在LightLoc架构上增加各向异性高斯协方差预测头、使用负对数似然损失与空间平滑正则化训练，并改进SC2-PCR求解器使其具备不确定性加权的种子评分和马氏距离内点检验，从而在提升6-DoF定位精度的同时产生良好校准的不确定性估计。

papers.title: NeSy-RAG: Neuro-Symbolic RAG for Explainable Question Answering
papers.authors: Jonas Gann, Michael Gertz
papers.affiliations: Data Science Group, Heidelberg University, Germany
papers.intro: NeSy-RAG提出一种模块化神经符号RAG框架，通过从检索文本块合成可归因的Prolog模块并执行符号推理，实现了可解释、可验证的问答，同时通过符号知识缺口检测主动获取缺失的用户信息，显著优于传统RAG基线。

papers.title: OTLesMix: Wasserstein Barycenter and Optimal Transport Map for Synthetic Lesion Generation with Diverse Shapes and Locations
papers.authors: Robin Trombetta, Carole Lartizien
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, image generation, medical image
papers.affiliations: Univ. Lyon, CNRS UMR 5220, Inserm U1294, INSA Lyon, UCBL, CREATIS, France
papers.intro: 本文提出OTLesMix，利用Wasserstein重心和最优传输图来生成形状和位置多样化且真实的合成病灶，并作为数据增强手段显著提升脑部病灶分割性能。

papers.title: EmoWorld: A Decoupled Affective Field for Controllable Emotional Video Generation
papers.authors: Bingyuan Wang, Baistan Zhyldyzbekov, Kunyu Feng, Zeyu Wang
papers.affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou); The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
papers.intro: EmoWorld提出一种在冻结的视频扩散Transformer（Video DiT）中解耦全局氛围、语义情感线索和时间演化的训练-free控制框架，通过三种互补的情感导向算子（VAS、SAS、TAS）实现可控情感视频生成。

papers.title: CFGPNet: Cross-Attention-Based Fused Gradient Programmed Network Framework for Multispectral Object Detection
papers.authors: Nima Hatami, Karim Faez, Saeed Sharifian, Hamidreza Amindavar
papers.affiliations: Department of Electrical Engineering, Amirkabir University of Technology, 15914, Tehran, Iran
papers.intro: CFGPNet 提出了一种基于交叉注意力的融合梯度编程网络框架，通过改进的 GELAN/RepViT 骨干、CrossCEA 高效跨模态交互、ASAF 选择性聚合融合以及可编程梯度辅助分支，在五个多光谱目标检测基准上取得了高精度与计算效率的良好平衡。

papers.title: Visual Grounding in Zero-Shot Vision-Language Control
papers.authors: J. de Curtò, Dayani Plasencia, Diego Sánchez, I. de Zarzà
papers.affiliations: 未明确（多个机构，见“作者机构”部分）
papers.intro: 本文通过系统化的输入消融测试组证明，现有VLM不能作为整体零样本控制器，但可以充当受约束的、纵向危险检测辅助模块，并在结合确定性感知时达到可验证的镜像等变性和高平衡准确率。

papers.title: Learning visual representations for compositional analysis of artworks and photographs
papers.authors: Fatemeh Behrad, Tinne Tuytelaars, Johan Wagemans
papers.affiliations: KU Leuven University, Belgium
papers.intro: 该论文系统比较了两种构图表示学习范式——基于感知分组原理的对象中心表示（Object-Centric Learning + 图注意力网络）与基于大规模数据集微调的自监督基础模型——并评估了它们在构图评分/类别预测、构图图像检索和视觉显著性检测等下游任务上的表现。
